scope: Exploratory live D435i/VINS/localization/depth-map/EGO occupancy sampling with one static box and one static cylinder before a broad calibration wall.
qualification: Preliminary GOAL B/C/F geometry evidence only. The run does not qualify planning, tracking, clearance, collision avoidance, PX4 control, or any formal threshold.

environment.truth_isolation: Gazebo pose is recorded by the diagnostic motion/evaluation process for offline alignment only. Raw VINS probe reports diagnostic_truth_enabled=false and truth_topic=null; VINS, localization, mapping and EGO receive no truth input.
environment.control_scope: No PX4, control bridge, trajectory tracking controller, or control publisher was started.

scene.reference_wall: Existing 0.1 x 12 x 8 m calibration wall centered at [3.05, 0, 1] m.

runtime.ego_planner_state: INIT; repeated 'no odom' / 'wait for goal or trigger' messages; no goal was submitted.

ego_odometry_wiring.qualification: EGO INIT/no-goal observations from this run do not establish planner readiness; occupancy and offline geometry observations remain independently usable.

offline_geometry_evaluation.alignment: Single SE(3), fixed scale 1, no segment realignment; alignment uses the diagnostic truth trajectory and does not use map points.

interpretation: The captured occupancy cloud contains points within the configured 0.25 m regions around both primitive obstacles. The sample gives a second geometry type beyond the wall, but the run's localization health gate later locked and EGO stayed INIT; these residuals are descriptive and do not establish planner use or clearance.
excluded_attempts: An initial standalone gz sdf check rejected the generated wall link's pre-existing duplicate collision/visual name. The generated diagnostic scene now renames only that collision to wall_collision; source calibration world is unchanged, and the second scene preflight reports Valid.

The first offline evaluator invocation failed while converting relative artifact paths to repository-relative hashes; path resolution was corrected and the report was regenerated from the same run inputs.
limitations: One exploratory run only; localization locked at 41.255 wall seconds due to normalized_cost_exceeded.
The occupancy cloud stores the largest observed PointCloud2, not a persistent snapshot. Object regions contain only 30 box points and 34 cylinder points.

EGO remained INIT and no navigation goal, planner response, trajectory tracking, collision contact, or minimum vehicle clearance was measured. The launch used odometry_topic:=odom, which did not match /localization/optimized_imu_odom; its INIT/no-goal state is not planner-readiness evidence.
No map free/unknown classification, inflation coverage, latency budget, braking distance, or failure exit timing was evaluated.
No GOAL F thresholds are frozen; this report cannot start or pass formal D/E acceptance.
next_step: Follow-up runs #248–#251 corrected the odometry topic/install diagnosis and verified the reliable QoS path; #251 kept EGO in manual WAIT_TARGET with no goal and produced a multi-geometry occupancy sample. Continue with quantified obstacle representation/inflation, end-of-window stale-input cause, repeatable localization, and measured clearance/tracking before freezing GOAL F.

execution_validation.generated_world_sdf: PASS on scene-preflight-02.sdf with gz sdf -k; the actual debug-motion.sdf was launched by Gazebo in the run.
execution_validation.xvfb: PASS after authenticated xdpyinfo readiness check and targeted SIGUSR1 to container PID 1.
execution_validation.offline_evaluator: PASS after path-resolution correction; output is multi-geometry-report.json.
execution_validation.container_cleanup: PASS; no active container remained after wrapper exit.
